quarterly_data.signal: Began sampling MI450 series GPUs to lead customers; Helios rack-scale (Instinct GPUs + EPYC Venice CPUs) on track to ramp production in H2 2026; lead-customer MI450 forecasts now exceed initial plans with additional multi-gigawatt opportunities emerging
Strong, increasing confidence in tens of billions of dollars of annual Data Center AI revenue in 2027, exceeding the >80% long-term CAGR target

ANTHROPIC COMMITS TO UP TO 2 GIGAWATTS OF MI450: AMD disclosed an agreement for Anthropic 'to deploy UP TO 2 GIGAWATTS OF MI450 SERIES GPUs IN AMD HELIOS RACKS', together with a MULTIYEAR COLLABORATION to optimise AMD Instinct GPUs and ROCm software development USING CLAUDE. This is the largest named MI450/Helios commitment to date and converts the 'additional multi-gigawatt opportunities' flagged last quarter into a specific customer and scale. CEO Lisa Su framed the second half around it: 'we enter the second half with strong momentum as EPYC demand accelerates, INSTINCT DEPLOYMENTS SCALE AND HELIOS BEGINS TO RAMP.' New silicon named in the quarter: MI455X, bringing leadership compute, memory capacity and bandwidth for large-scale AI training and inference, and MI430X, positioned as the most advanced accelerator for HPC and SOVEREIGN AI workloads.
quarterly_data.figure: Anthropic to deploy UP TO 2 GW of MI450 in Helios racks + multiyear ROCm collaboration using Claude

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 record results: revenue $11.5B, UP 50% year over year, with GAAP gross margin 54% (non-GAAP 56%), GAAP operating income $2.0B (non-GAAP $3.1B), GAAP net income $2.3B (non-GAAP $2.8B) and GAAP diluted EPS $1.38 (non-GAAP $1.66). DATA CENTER SEGMENT REVENUE $6.7 BILLION, UP 107% YEAR OVER YEAR — more than doubling on EPYC processors and Instinct GPUs — and now 58% OF TOTAL COMPANY REVENUE. Client and Gaming $3.8B (+6%; Client $3.1B +23% on Ryzen, Gaming $779M -31% on lower semi-custom); Embedded $977M (+19%). Q3 2026 GUIDANCE: revenue approximately $13 BILLION +/- $300M, representing roughly +41% year over year and +13% sequentially, with non-GAAP gross margin around 56%. CFO Jean Hu: 'We expect DATA CENTER SALES TO ACCELERATE IN THE SECOND HALF of 2026, driving stronger overall revenue growth and continued earnings expansion.' (Prior-year comparisons are flattered by $800M of inventory and related charges taken in Q2 2025 on the US export control covering Instinct MI308.)
quarterly_data.figure: Record rev $11.5B (+50%); Data Center $6.7B (+107%) = 58% of revenue; Q3 guide ~$13B (+41% YoY)

quarterly_data.signal: HPE building a scale-up Ethernet switch purpose-built for the AMD Helios AI rack-scale architecture (introduction expected fall 2026), part of HPE's scale-up / scale-out / scale-across AI networking strategy; first OEM to ship a Broadcom Tomahawk 6 100% liquid-cooled switch.

HPE is the FIRST OEM to productize a Broadcom Tomahawk-6-based, 100% liquid-cooled switch (1.6 Tbps, 'HelioStack' reference architecture, introducing in fall 2026), with a roadmap extending through co-packaged optics for lower power. Raised the cumulative FY2026 Networks-for-AI order target to at least $2B; data-center networking & routing revenue grew 69%, with Juniper PTX (800G density) winning data-center-interconnect deployments at large cloud service providers. Scale-up (Helios switch) + scale-out (QFX fabric) + scale-across (PTX DCI) covered.
